title: Sneakfingers and the Pies
story: The village baker made 12 beautiful berry pies for the Harvest Festival. But in the night, Sneakfingers the Shadow Thief crept in and snatched 5 of them! The baker needs Mr 6's help to know if there are enough pies left.
question: How many pies does the baker have left?
hint: Start with 12 and take away 5. Try counting backward: 11, 10, 9...
victory: Mr 6 follows the trail of berry drips, catches Sneakfingers mid-bite, and marches him back to wash dishes for the baker all festival long. All pies accounted for!
solution: The baker starts with 12 pies and 5 are taken.
praise: Taking away the stolen pies was exactly right - it just looks like the counting back stopped a step early. So close!
